name: Frame Windows
description: Calculates how many frames each click of a .gdr2 macro has and shows it with markers.

macro-path.name: Macro (.gdr2)
macro-path.description: Macro file that is analyzed and played back in Showcase.

max-shift.name: Max click shift (frames)
max-shift.description: How many frames to test in each direction. Windows of 20+ frames are shown as '20+'.

lookahead.name: Lookahead (frames)
lookahead.description: How many frames after the click are simulated to check that the player survives. More = more accurate but slower.
